Title: Aditya's Day

Cast

1. Aditya - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Sonali - 34 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Anil - 44 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
4. Siya - 11 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress
5. Sharda - 70 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches
4. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Sonali, Anil and Sharda stand near him.]

Aditya: "What lovely weather!"

[Aditya jumps with joy.]

Aditya: "Yes, all right."

[Aditya pats his horse.]

Sonali (excited): "Let's see."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Sonali and Anil stand near him.]

Aditya: "What a nice place."

[Aditya combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Anil: "Let's see."

[Aditya sips hot tea from a cup.]

Aditya (laughing): "Hmm, I see."

[Aditya sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Anil: "Really?"

[Aditya talks to his father on the phone.]

Sonali (surprised): "Careful!"

[Aditya types on his laptop.]

Sonali: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Aditya opens the window.]

Anil: "Show me too!"

Scene 3: The park - Day

[Aditya stands in the park. Sonali and Anil stand near him.]

Aditya: "So, here we are!"

[Aditya catches the ball.]

Aditya: "One more time!"

[Aditya kicks the football hard.]

Aditya (happily): "This is amazing!"

[Aditya swings on the swing.]

Aditya: "Show me too!"

[Aditya goes down the slide.]

Aditya (laughing): "Okay, Dad."

[Aditya plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Sonali: "Hey, look at that!"

[Aditya plays with his dog.]

Aditya: "What next?"

[Aditya feeds the birds.]

Aditya: "Exactly right."

Scene 4: The road - Day

[Aditya stands by the road. Sonali and Anil stand near him.]

Sonali: "What a nice place."

[Aditya gets into the car.]

Aditya: "That's easy."

[Aditya hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Aditya: "What a day to remember!"
